reason: The largest number of letters at which the widest group of a one-letter word and the next word from the site's texts fits the narrowest line with the text at 200 %: paragraphs, headings, list items, table headers and cells, data-label, ui-badge and ui-pill-button on a phone 320 pt wide and in the administration's tables 900 and 1000 px wide. Measured by e2e/largest-text.spec.ts ('Given the longest word a one-letter word keeps beside it…'), which fails when this number differs from the measurement: the binding place is a table cell of a donor's card 900 and 1000 px wide, 121 px, where 'v bance…' (5 letters) needs 130 px. A no-break space is required up to this length; before a longer word it stays only where the group fits, which the 200 % checks of e2e/accessibility-keyboard.spec.ts guard.
